task_name: Classify sea ice concentration from SAR object properties
task_description: The retained core workflow trains a Random Forest classifier using SAR HH/HV object-property features and labeled ice-concentration samples, then applies the classifier to create a sea-ice concentration raster output.
original_task_description: The script classifies sea ice concentration using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, specifically HH and HV backscatter means, trained with a Random Forest classifier on labeled ice concentration data. It performs both training and validation using separate feature collections, outputs a classified raster map of ice concentration, and evaluates accuracy through confusion matrices and overall accuracy metrics for both training and validation datasets.
known_omissions: ["external feature collections and labeled sample provenance are source context", "validation classifier", "confusion matrices and accuracy metrics", "Map display, print output, and display/export noise"]

task_name: Quantify built-up surface area from thresholded GHSL raster
task_description: Select and clip the GHSL built-up surface raster, derive equality and threshold masks for built-up categories, apply those masks to pixel area images, and summarize total and new built-up area with reduceRegion.
original_task_description: The script analyzes the JRC/GHSL built-up surface dataset to identify and quantify urbanized areas within a user-defined region. It applies threshold-based masking to distinguish total and newly developed built-up areas (using class values), computes their respective pixel areas, and outputs a classified map of built-up intensity with visual styling, along with total and new built-up area statistics derived from pixel summation over the region.
known_omissions: ["map styling, display, and print outputs", "classified-map or built-up intensity visualization language", "broader urbanization interpretation beyond threshold-mask area statistics"]
